prose: The episode-notes edition of Latent Space's Jacob Lauritzen (Legora CTO) interview - the condensed chapter list and takeaway summary of the same conversation. Useful as a map: the questions listed are the ones the field is actually asking - how to evaluate agents you can't observe, which tasks still need better models (Lauritzen estimates current models do about 60% of legal work well), how legal engineers and forward-deployed engineers split the work, and whether labs will cut off legal tools the way they squeezed coding tools.
